entries.reason: the key of the cancelled flag in the info of a content editing request, of iOS 8; the claim is about the release: iOS 6 has no content editing at all: its photo library is ALAssetsLibrary, which adds and reads an asset and edits none, so there is no request, no input, no output and no adjustment data whose info could carry this key. The value the release's own Photos holds is the string "PHContentEditingInputCancelledKey", which is its own name (facts/Photos/Constants.md)
entries.effect: the symbol is not there: a weak reference to it is NULL. Its value, once the family is carried, has to be "PHContentEditingInputCancelledKey"
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the declaration; tools/corpus/cache-value.lua over the arm64e cache of 16.0 for the value, read out of the device's own Photos.framework; tools/cache-index/first-rung.py for the first held rung that carries the name; facts/Photos/Constants.md for all of it
